meta.title: Farming Armor Reforge Selection and Cost Matrix
meta.purpose: Choose the armor reforge by farming objective instead of applying one global recommendation. Separates direct Farming Fortune from Bonus Pest Chance and Pest-driven expected value.
meta.refresh_policy: Refresh reforge-stone Bazaar prices before player-facing upgrade ranking. Reforge stats are mechanics data; market prices are dated fallbacks.

core_rule.statement: There is no universal farming-armor reforge winner across all contexts.
core_rule.normal_crop_axis: Direct Farming Fortune favors Mossy over Bustling/Mantid at equal item rarity.
core_rule.pest_axis: Mantid trades direct Farming Fortune for Bonus Pest Chance and a temporary kill-stacking Bonus Pest Chance effect.
core_rule.optimizer: Score the complete active armor set in the selected context using before/after profit or the context metric. Never rank Mossy vs Mantid from Farming Fortune alone when Pest EV is active.

reforges.name: Bustling
reforges.selection_rule: Use as the low-cost direct-Farming-Fortune stepping stone when Mossy is not yet economical. Do not keep it merely because it is cheap if the marginal gain from Mossy has acceptable payback.

reforges.name: Mossy
reforges.selection_rule: Default direct-output reforge for an armor piece when maximizing crop Farming Fortune is the relevant objective and the price/payback is justified.

mythic_vs_legendary_recomb_delta.note: Recombobulation can therefore add reforge value in addition to other rarity-scaled effects; price the exact item before ranking.

reforges.name: Mantid

reforge_bonus.name: Mantid Bonus
reforge_bonus.four_piece_cap_source_note: Current Bonus Pest Chance reference lists Mantid Claw +10 base BPC and 20 recent Pest kills +20 BPC for a full four-piece setup.

reforges.selection_rule: Use when Bonus Pest Chance / Pest spawning / Pest EV is the objective or when a full profit model shows the extra Pest stream outweighs the direct Farming Fortune lost versus Mossy.

selection_matrix.reason: Direct Farming Fortune at a far lower acquisition cost than Overgrown Grass.
selection_matrix.transition_rule: Replace piece-by-piece with Mossy when the exact marginal profit/payback justifies it.

selection_matrix.reason: Highest direct Farming Fortune of the three Farming-focused armor reforges at the same rarity.
selection_matrix.metric: crop output / net coins per hour

selection_matrix.reason: Direct Farming Fortune is the relevant armor-reforge contribution unless a contest-specific Pest mechanic is explicitly part of the measured strategy.
Adds Bonus Pest Chance plus Mantid Bonus. Direct Farming Fortune is lower than Mossy, so the calculator must include Pest EV and Pest handling time.
Mixed Mossy/Mantid and full Mantid/Mossy setups depend on live Pest value, Bonus Pest Chance, active Mantid stacks, crop value, Pest handling downtime, armor rarity and the player's actual set.
selection_matrix.rule: Evaluate all legal candidate mixes; do not encode an internet 'meta' as a universal winner.

community_strategy_notes.claim: Recent community discussion commonly separates a high-Farming-Fortune Mossy set from a Pest/BPC Mantid set, and some players use mixed Mossy/Mantid setups.
community_strategy_notes.optimizer_use: Generate candidate setups only. Final ranking must come from the calculator.

anti_patterns: Do not recommend Ancient for pure Farming solely because Mooshroom Cow converts Strength; current Farming reforges provide much larger direct relevant stats in normal Farming use.
Do not call Bustling obsolete for every player; its acquisition cost makes it a valid budget progression state.
Do not call Mossy universally best when Pest EV is part of the objective.
Do not multiply the Mantid dynamic bonus without respecting per-piece cap, 10-minute kill window and the player's actual number of Mantid-reforged pieces.
Do not sum Farm-set and Pest-set armor simultaneously.

calculator_integration.candidate_unit: one concrete armor piece at its actual rarity and active set mode
required_state: recent Pest kills / Mantid stack state when relevant
Pest EV and Pest handling time for Pest/hybrid contexts
calculator_integration.economic_rule: Score the whole before/after active setup; use net coins/hour for economic contexts and contest collection/score for Jacob contexts.
calculator_integration.unknown_rule: If Pest EV, Mantid stack state, live price or relevant crop model is unknown, mark the hybrid comparison incomplete instead of silently choosing Mossy or Mantid.
